elements.requirement: Subsection (1) applies where an employer proposes to dismiss as redundant, within a period of 90 days or less, either at least the threshold number of employees or 20 or more employees at one establishment.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) applies where an employer is proposing to dismiss as redundant within a period of 90 days or less— (a) at least the threshold number of employees (see section 195A), or (b) 20 or more employees at one establishment.

elements.requirement: The employer must consult about the dismissals all persons who are appropriate representatives of any employees who may be affected by the proposed dismissals or by measures taken in connection with those dismissals.
elements.quote: The employer shall consult about the dismissals all the persons who are appropriate representatives of any of the employees who may be affected by the proposed dismissals or may be affected by measures taken in connection with those dismissals.

elements.requirement: Consultation must begin in good time and, where the employer proposes to dismiss 100 or more employees as mentioned in subsection (A1), at least 45 days before the first of the dismissals takes effect.
elements.quote: The consultation shall begin in good time and in any event— (a) where the employer is proposing to dismiss 100 or more employees as mentioned in subsection (1) (A1), at least 45 days

elements.requirement: Consultation must begin in good time and, where the employer is proposing to dismiss fewer than 100 employees as mentioned in subsection (A1), at least 30 days before the first dismissal takes effect.
elements.quote: (b) otherwise, at least 30 days, before the first of the dismissals takes effect.

elements.requirement: Where affected employees are of a description for which an independent trade union is recognised by their employer, the appropriate representatives are representatives of that trade union.
elements.quote: if the employees are of a description in respect of which an independent trade union is recognised by their employer, representatives of the trade union

elements.requirement: Where no independent trade union is recognised for the affected employees, the employer may choose as appropriate representatives employee representatives appointed or elected by affected employees otherwise than for the purposes of section 188 who have authority from those employees to receive information and be consulted on their behalf.
elements.quote: employee representatives appointed or elected by the affected employees otherwise than for the purposes of this section, who (having regard to the purposes for and the method by which they were appointed or elected) have authority from those employees to receive information and to be consulted about the proposed dismissals on their behalf

elements.requirement: Where no independent trade union is recognised for the affected employees, the employer may choose as appropriate representatives employee representatives elected by the affected employees for the purposes of section 188 in an election satisfying section 188A(1).
elements.quote: employee representatives elected by the affected employees, for the purposes of this section, in an election satisfying the requirements of section 188A(1).

elements.requirement: Consultation must include ways of avoiding dismissals, reducing the numbers of employees to be dismissed, and mitigating the consequences of dismissals, and must be undertaken by the employer with a view to reaching agreement with appropriate representatives.
elements.quote: The consultation shall include consultation about ways of— (a) avoiding the dismissals, (b) reducing the numbers of employees to be dismissed, and (c) mitigating the consequences of the dismissals, and shall be undertaken by the employer with a view to reaching agreement with the appropriate representatives.

elements.requirement: The employer is not required to consult all appropriate representatives together or to undertake consultation with a view to reaching the same agreement with all appropriate representatives.
elements.quote: This section does not require the employer to— (a) consult all of the appropriate representatives together, or (b) undertake the consultation with a view to reaching the same agreement with all of the appropriate representatives.

elements.requirement: When determining how many employees an employer is proposing to dismiss as redundant, employees for whom proposed dismissal consultation has already begun must not be counted.
elements.quote: In determining how many employees an employer is proposing to dismiss as redundant no account shall be taken of employees in respect of whose proposed dismissals consultation has already begun.

elements.requirement: For consultation purposes, the employer must disclose in writing to appropriate representatives the reasons for the proposals and the numbers and descriptions of employees proposed for redundancy dismissal.
elements.quote: the employer shall disclose in writing to the appropriate representatives— (a) the reasons for his proposals, (b) the numbers and descriptions of employees whom it is proposed to dismiss as redundant

elements.requirement: Where employees proposed for redundancy dismissal are at only one establishment, the employer must disclose in writing the total number of employees of that description employed at that establishment.
elements.quote: (c) where the employees whom it is proposed to dismiss as redundant are at only one establishment, the total number of employees of any such description employed by the employer at the establishment in question

elements.requirement: Where employees proposed for redundancy dismissal are at more than one establishment, the employer must disclose in writing the total number of employees of that description employed by the employer and details of the establishments where they are employed.
elements.quote: (ca) where the employees whom it is proposed to dismiss as redundant are at more than one establishment— (i) the total number of employees of any such description employed by the employer, and (ii) details of the establishments at which those employees are employed

elements.requirement: The employer must disclose in writing the proposed method of selecting employees who may be dismissed.
elements.quote: (d) the proposed method of selecting the employees who may be dismissed

elements.requirement: The employer must disclose in writing the proposed method of carrying out dismissals, with due regard to any agreed procedure, including the period over which the dismissals take effect.
elements.quote: (e) the proposed method of carrying out the dismissals, with due regard to any agreed procedure, including the period over which the dismissals are to take effect.

elements.requirement: The employer must disclose in writing the proposed method of calculating any non-statutory redundancy payments to be made to employees who may be dismissed.
elements.quote: (f) the proposed method of calculating the amount of any redundancy payments to be made (otherwise than in compliance with an obligation imposed by or by virtue of any enactment) to employees who may be dismissed.

elements.requirement: The employer must disclose in writing the number of agency workers working temporarily for and under the employer's supervision and direction, the parts of the undertaking where they work, and the type of work they carry out.
elements.quote: (g) the number of agency workers working temporarily for and under the supervision and direction of the employer, (h) the parts of the employer’s undertaking in which those agency workers are working, and (i) the type of work those agency workers are carrying out.

elements.requirement: Information required to be disclosed must be delivered to each appropriate representative, sent by post to an address they notified to the employer, or, for trade union representatives, sent by post to the union's head or main office address.
elements.quote: That information shall be given to each of the appropriate representatives by being delivered to them, or sent by post to an address notified by them to the employer, or (in the case of representatives of a trade union) sent by post to the union at the address of its head or main office.

elements.requirement: The employer must allow appropriate representatives access to affected employees and must afford them appropriate accommodation and other facilities.
elements.quote: The employer shall allow the appropriate representatives access to the affected employees and shall afford to those representatives such accommodation and other facilities as may be appropriate.

elements.requirement: Where special circumstances make full compliance with subsection (1A), (2), or (4) not reasonably practicable, the employer must take all steps towards compliance that are reasonably practicable in those circumstances.
elements.quote: If in any case there are special circumstances which render it not reasonably practicable for the employer to comply with a requirement of subsection (1A), (2) or (4), the employer shall take all such steps towards compliance with that requirement as are reasonably practicable in those circumstances.

elements.requirement: Where a decision leading to proposed dismissals is taken by a person directly or indirectly controlling the employer, that person's failure to provide information to the employer does not constitute special circumstances making compliance not reasonably practicable.
elements.quote: Where the decision leading to the proposed dismissals is that of a person controlling the employer (directly or indirectly), a failure on the part of that person to provide information to the employer shall not constitute special circumstances rendering it not reasonably practicable for the employer to comply with such a requirement.

elements.requirement: An employer who invited affected employees to elect representatives sufficiently in advance of the consultation deadline to allow election by that time is treated as complying with section 188 if compliance occurs as soon as reasonably practicable after the election.
elements.quote: the employer shall be treated as complying with the requirements of this section in relation to those employees if he complies with those requirements as soon as is reasonably practicable after the election of the representatives.

elements.requirement: If affected employees fail to elect representatives within a reasonable time after being invited to do so, the employer must provide the information specified in subsection (4) to each affected employee.
elements.quote: If, after the employer has invited affected employees to elect representatives, the affected employees fail to do so within a reasonable time, he shall give to each affected employee the information set out in subsection (4).

elements.requirement: Section 188 does not confer rights on a trade union, representative, or employee except as provided by sections 189 to 192.
elements.quote: This section does not confer any rights on a trade union , a representative or an employee except as provided by sections 189 to 192 below.
